claim: For 0<alpha<1 and1<=p<2 the frozen localized coupling has E_p norm <=C delta^(2-p); choosing p with1+pA-Dalpha>0 yields an inverse for everyalpha<1 at sufficiently small delta.
method: Independent partial Fourier resolvent in y, weighted exponential kernel moments, separate low-frequency block, exact cutoff product and maximal-domain Neumann inverse. Exact compact potential counterexample to derivative necessity.
scope: Frozen transport and localized coupling only. Actual transport, strain column, normalization and nonlinear closure are outside the claim. Independent Opus cross-audit requested.
